title: How many pizzas to fill the whole world?
container_volume_note: Earth as a sphere of mean radius 6,371 km: 4/3 x pi x r^3
item_note: 14-inch (35.6 cm) pizza, 2 cm thick: pi x 0.178^2 x 0.02 m^3
packing_note: pizzas stacked in towers, towers packed as tightly as circles go (pi / 2 sqrt 3)

milestones.text: 1 PIZZA FOR EVERY PERSON ON EARTH

footnote: Pizza = 14 in (35.6 cm) wide, 2 cm thick, ~0.8 kg, stacked in towers packed as tight as circles go (90.7%). Earth = 4/3 x pi x (6,371 km)³ = 1.08 x 10²¹ m³.
